summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K under Rule 13a-16 as a foreign private issuer, reporting the discovery of hydrocarbons in the Morpho exploratory well (1-BRSA-1405-APS) in Block FZA-M-59, offshore Amapá, Brazil. Petrobras operates the block with a 100% participating interest, acquired under a concession regime in ANP's 11th Licensing Round (2013). The well is at 2,886 meters water depth, and operations are ongoing. This is an operational update on exploration results, disclosed under the SEC's rules for foreign issuers. No transaction, tender, merger, or special-situation event is described.
